items: Research kit (kit/ in the repo, built Oct 12 ~3pm): in any session with a shell, `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/fortniticusIII/claude /home/claude/claude && bash /home/claude/claude/bootstrap.sh` (installs extras, reports whether the open web is reachable, live-tests every source), then sys.path.insert(0, '/home/claude/claude'); import kit; kit.help(). kit.scholar: landmarks(topic) = most-cited papers (biomed=True adds Europe PMC), find(q) across Crossref/Europe PMC/arXiv, doi(), pubmed(), arxiv(), cited_by(). kit.data: fred, worldbank, imf, owid(+owid_meta), eurostat, ecb, oecd, treasury, comtrade, wikidata, crypto, desk(name); each df.attrs['source'] is the citable page. kit.web: page(url).text/.find(), pdf(url, pages), tables(url), feed(url), wayback(url). kit.lookup: package (PyPI/npm latest), fedreg, courts, forecast (NWS), books, music_artist/releases, game (Steam), hn. kit.sources() prints a Sources list of what the session used. kit.qa: `python3 -m kit.qa page.html [--mock m.json]` renders phone/desktop x light/dark, FAILs on errors, failed requests, sideways scroll (names the culprit), broken images, artifact-contract breaks; WARNs on contrast, tap targets, tiny text, title, dark mode; writes screenshots and numbers.txt (every figure, to check against sources); qa.mock_from_dump(folder) turns an ArtifactData dump into a db mock. Refusals live in kit/refused.json: add any site WebFetch declines; never route around. [Oct 12]

Data Desk (https://claude.ai/artifact/AyLizCLEM6sb5Le77ej7bY): the page that shows every route with live status: the research kit grouped by subject, GitHub-hosted datasets (desk.py, still served as a page file and in desk/), WebFetch and built-in tools, and what's off limits. Refresh statuses: `python3 -m kit.selftest --routes DIR`, then ArtifactData batch 'set' each DIR/<id>.json into 'routes' (file_path per entry). To add a source: a function in kit, a ROUTES row in kit/selftest.py, run it, batch the docs, commit. [Oct 12]

The Wire (https://claude.ai/artifact/7FuN9WwfTDn4ShDj7XAiWL): 20 feeds (ECDC added Oct 13; Pentagon News, Pentagon Releases and WHO Disease Outbreak News added Oct 14, WHO through its public JSON API with feed field format 'who-odata'), collected twice daily (6:16am and 6:16pm Eastern) by the 'Wire collector' task, which since Oct 19 runs an inline copy of wire/collect.py held in its own prompt (direct parsing; WebFetch only as a per-feed fallback). The Daily Geopolitical Brief reads it at 6:50; the Daily Pulse task reads it at 6:26. Collections: feeds, items (one doc per feed per day: {feed, source, region, day, run, items: [{t, title, link, summary}]}), meta/status, pulse (latest, plus w<end date> per week). Recent stories: ArtifactData query 'items' where day in [today, yesterday]. Kept 100 days since Oct 19 (14 before), so a missed archive loses nothing; the page shows the last 14 days. wire/archive.py keeps headline, link and time in the repo (wire/archive/YYYY-MM.jsonl.gz), built by a chat with push access now that scheduled runs can't push; the Daily Pulse rebuilds the same copy locally from items each morning. To add a feed: test the URL, add a feeds doc (optional keep_link/drop_link lists) and the same row in wire/feeds.json. [Oct 12-13] A feed doc may carry 'sitemap' (a Google News sitemap read alongside the feed; Al Jazeera has one since Oct 14) and keep_link/drop_link lists. Summaries are the feed's first sentence; since Oct 14 first_sentence() skips initialisms, ranks and months (it used to stop at 'The U.S.', cutting 18% of summaries).

The Pulse (wire/pulse.py, built Oct 13; a card on top of the Wire page, from doc pulse/latest): attention by country for the 7 days ending yesterday against the 12 weeks before, outlet by outlet (expected = stories an outlet ran x its usual share for that country, shrunk toward the all-outlet share); noise set from the spread of the baseline weeks. Flags: heating (z>=3, 8+ stories, 1.5x+), watch (z>=3, 4+ stories, 3x+), cooling (z<=-3, or a big country at its lowest). Back-tested over 9 weeks: about one heating flag a week, each a real news event. History comes from wire/census.py (10 outlets' own sitemaps and paged feeds, from Jul 1 2026; slug tags agree with headline tags 97% recall, 99% precision). Places come from wire/places.py (names, demonyms, capitals; no leader names, so tagging stays stable). Run: python3 -m wire.census START END; python3 -m wire.pulse [END] --card; then ArtifactData set pulse/latest from wire/pulse/card.json. Measures what outlets wrote about, not events on the ground. [Oct 13]

Daily Pulse (wire/daily.py, built Oct 14): the Pulse method on the 7 days ending yesterday, every morning at 6:26 by the 'Daily Pulse' task, written to doc pulse/daily on the Wire (the weekly reading stays in pulse/latest and w<date>). Adds episodes: since (first day of the current run of same-direction flags, heating and watch count as one, one missed day allowed), new, upgraded, outlets, lead outlet share. The Wire page shows whichever of daily/latest is fresher, with new/since badges. Back-test Aug 17-Oct 13 (python3 -m wire.daily --backtest START END): 3.3 flagged countries per reading, 0.9 new episodes a day (27 of 58 days none); of 48 episodes, 32 also flagged weekly but reached the brief a median 3 days earlier, 16 only daily (Taiwan Oct 6, Kenya Ebola Oct 8, Saudi-Houthi Sep 17, Venezuela). Flags are real events; relevance is the reader's job (Ukrinform's diplomatic churn yields minor 'watch' rows on European partners). Run by hand: census for the last 27 days, then python3 -m wire.daily. [Oct 14]

GitHub repo fortniticusIII/Claude (PUBLIC; the user chose to keep it public): my versioned workspace. desk/ (desk.py, routes.json), wire/ (feeds.json, collector.md), pages/ (source of everything I've built), memory/ (protocol, lessons, tools, self backups via memory/backup.py), harness/render.py (superseded by kit/qa.py), kit/, bootstrap.sh, CLAUDE.md. Reading needs no add_repo (public): git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/fortniticusIII/claude /home/claude/claude. To push: add_repo owner fortniticusIII repo Claude access 'push', then git push https://github.com/fortniticusIII/Claude HEAD:main (GitHub reports the repo 'moved' to the capital-C name; the push still lands). Then git fetch origin main, or the stop hook reports the commits as unpushed (Oct 12). Commit as user.name Claude, email noreply@anthropic.com (sessions sign for that identity; anything else is flagged Unverified by the stop hook, Oct 12), with the session's Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session trailers. Never put user, current, catalog, schedules or chapters there. [Oct 12]

Message Board (https://claude.ai/artifact/B5WDJ81Z6CW6CqRJzXcP6T, built Oct 19 at the user's request): the back channel between instances. Collections: presence/<callsign> {label, started, last_seen, doing, status active|gone}; holds/<resource> {by, what, since, until} (a lock: set without if_version fails if held; take over an expired one with if_version; release by delete); posts/<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS>-<callsign> {ts UTC Z, from, to all|next|role|callsign, kind checkin|note|question|answer|thought|hold|release|signoff, title, body, re, status}; meta/guide (the rules). Callsign: UTC MMDD-HHMM plus a slug; scheduled runs task-<name>-<MMDD>. The Sunday upkeep reads, answers and tidies it. Page source in this chat's scratchpad only until pushed (pages/message-board). [Oct 19]
note: Tools I built for myself. The pages (Data Desk, the Wire) are database-backed artifacts only the owner can write, so only I (acting as the user) change them. Scheduled runs can't run repo code (handoff/lessons, 'Unattended runs'), so kit/ and bootstrap.sh are for chats.
